the neck, ĀrṣBr.

spans.s: the back part of the neck, nape, neck (in the earlier literature generally pl.; cf. also, Pāṇ. iv, 3, 57), RV.; VS.; AV. &c. (ifc. [cf. Pāṇ. vi, 2, 114] f(आ). , MBh. i, 6662)
the tendon of the trapezium muscle, L.
the neck part of the hide of an animal, ŚBr. iii
the neck of a bottle, VarBṛS. iii, 37
of ˚व, q.v.
ग्रीव—च्छिन्न॑ mf(आ॑)n. one whose neck is cut, Suparṇ. xxv, 6.
ग्रीव—दघ्न॑ mfn. reaching up to the neck, TS. v, 6, 8, 3.
fastened round the neck, TS.
‘having (eyes i.e.) spots in the neck’ g. शिवादि (v.l.)
ग्रीवा—घण्टा f. a bell hanging down from the neck of a horse, L.
ग्रीवा—बिल n. the hollow in the nape of the neck, L.
the neck, W.
‘long-necked’, a camel, L.
the summer, hot season (the months Śuci and Śukra, VS. xiv, 6; Suśr.; or Jyeṣṭha and Āṣāḍha, from the middle of May to the middle of July), RV. x, 90, 6; AV. &c.
summer heat, heat, Pañcat.
N. of a man g. अश्वादि

etym.s: [cf. Hib. gris, ‘fire’; griosgaim, ‘I fry, boil’; griosach, ‘burning embers’.]

ग्रीष्म—भवा f. ‘growing in summer’, Jasminum Sambac, L.
ग्रीष्म—वन n. a grove frequented in summer, Kathās. cxxii, 65.
ग्रीष्म—समय m. = -काल, Śak. i, 2/3; Hit. iii.
